title: XiaoXue's ingenious ideas
description: An addon pack for TACZ and LesRaisins Tactical Equipments, adds some popular melee weapons from Anarea Breakout to the game.
body:
An addon pack for TACZ and LesRaisins Tactical Equipments, adds some popular melee weapons from Anarea Breakout to the game.
Includes many wonderful weapons
![weapons](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/df133a98a8c018cd682814a2b436827d58a802f0_0.webp)
You need tacz 1.1.6+ and lesraisins tactical 0.3.0+ above as dependency
